DRIPLINE

Ivy Green Hoodie

1

Crafted from soft cotton with a refined jersey texture, this ivy green hoodie combines a laid-back drop-shoulder fit with a classic drawstring hood. Designed for everyday comfort, it brings together casual ease and clean DRIP styling.

 

Material & Care

  • 100% Cotton with jersey knit texture

  • Machine wash cold with similar colors

  • Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry

  • Warm iron if needed, avoid ironing over drawstrings

Why DRIPLINE?

When will i receive my Order?

Orders typically ship within 2 business days. Delivery times vary by location, usually 3-5 business days.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit & debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex etc.) for a secure checkout.

Are your products authentic?

Yes, you will receive a certificate of authenticity with each product to guarantee it.
